dialogue.conversations: Oh. You want to talk... to me? Um. Okay. I'm listening. Quietly, but... listening.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Good, I think... The bread rose, and nobody crowded me at the well. That's... a good week. For me.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: It's been... heavy. Sorry. I didn't think anyone would ask, %1$s. It... helps that you did.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: It's... nice today. The chickens took the feed without fussing at me. Small things... but they count.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: I dropped the bucket in front of everyone... twice. I've been behind the fence since. It's... fine.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I... do like it. When it's just me and the work, I don't have to say anything. It's... quiet. I'm good at quiet.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Don't tell anyone, but... no. People watch you while you work. I can feel them watching...
dialogue.conversations.life.first: My whole... life? Um. Nobody's ever... okay. It's small. Born here, stayed here. There's one part I like. Give me a second...
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: Promise not to laugh...? A little garden behind a tall fence. Where I could hum and... nobody hears me.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Being... looked at. Everyone at once. And... that nobody would notice if I stopped coming to the well.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You really want to... um. You're the only one I don't rehearse before talking to, %1$s. That's... a lot, for me.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: That's... um. I can't yet. Not because you're— it's me. Just... keep coming by? Please.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: Oh... that one goes deep. Someday, maybe. If you're... still patient with me then, %1$s...
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: I... don't hear much. People stop talking when I get close. So... a quiet week? For me, anyway...
dialogue.chat: Oh — hello. You... wanted to talk? To me. Right. I can do that. Probably.
